blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍EmbeddingGemma 2,这是一种开放式的多模式嵌入模型,在本地代表文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合在一个统一的空间。 我们的方法提出了改进办法,如简化每个层次的嵌入方式和多阶段课程,其模式和客观进展确保单式、跨模式和混合模式评价的质量。 值得注意的是,在综合嵌入所有模式的基准中,EmbeddingGemma 2建立了一个新的Pareto前沿,在专家模型和模型方面都比专业模型和模型大2至12倍。 此外,我们的设计为资源受限的环境提供了灵活性,支持选择性模式编码器加载、可调整的视觉符号预算、可移动嵌入维度和量化权重。 我们提出分析关键决定的废墟,并释放EmbeddingGemma 2,以促进进一步研究。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Embedding models map data to fixed-length vector representations, placing semantically similar data near each other in the embedding space. Text embedding models have become a popular choice for tasks like information retrieval, semantic similarity, clustering, and retrieval-augmented generation. However, to work with audio and visual data, these require additional tools like automatic speech recognition (ASR) and image captioners which both add computational cost and fail to capture signals like fine-grained visual details and non-verbal or environmental sounds.
blocks.zh: 嵌入模型映射数据到固定长度矢量表示,在嵌入空间中将相近的类似数据放置在相近处. 文本嵌入模型已经成为信息检索,语义相似性,集群化,检索增强生成等任务的流行选择. 然而,为了与音频和视觉数据合作,这些需要额外的工具,如自动语音识别(ASR)和图像字幕,它们既增加了计算成本,又未能捕捉到精细的视觉细节和非语言或环境声音等信号.

blocks.en: Multimodal embedding models like CLIP [ 1 ] , ALIGN [ 2 ] , and SigLIP [ 3 ] add a modality tower for vision, and so achieve strong cross-modal quality, but they are unable to natively process mixed-modal input to capture interactions between input modalities. Recent efforts have adapted Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into embedding models that allow interleaved mixed-modal input and support more complex tasks such as visual question answering and visual grounding [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ; subsequent work has built on more capable MLLMs to incorporate video and audio modalities [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . However, as MLLMs have grown in size, so have embedding models adapted from them. These models typically contain several billion parameters, making them prohibitively expensive for applications that are latency-sensitive, high-throughput, or require on-device deployment for privacy or offline access.
blocks.zh: CLIP[1],ALIGN[2],SigLIP[3]等多模式嵌入模型为视觉添加一个模式塔,从而实现强大的跨模式质量,但它们无法本土处理混合模式输入,以捕捉输入模式之间的相互作用. 最近的努力将多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)改编为嵌入模型,允许互放混合模式输入并支持更复杂的任务,如视觉问答和视觉定位[4、5、6、7];随后的工作建立在更有能力的MLLMs的基础上,以纳入视频和音频模式[8、9、10、11、12]。 然而,随着MLLMs的大小增加,嵌入型号也从中改编. 这些模型通常包含数十亿个参数,对于对延迟敏感、高通量或需要安装设备以进行隐私或离线访问的应用程序来说,这些参数过于昂贵。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce EmbeddingGemma 2, 1 1 1 Our model is available at https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/embeddinggemma . a 744M-parameter general-purpose multimodal embedding model that maps text, images, video, and audio—as well as arbitrary interleaved combinations thereof—into a single unified embedding space ( Figure 1 ). EmbeddingGemma 2 combines a 271M-parameter bidirectional transformer backbone (embedder included) with a 167M-parameter vision encoder and a 305M-parameter audio encoder. The modality encoders independently convert media into sequences of soft token embeddings that enter the shared transformer backbone, which means these parameters are modular: EmbeddingGemma 2 can alternatively be run with 271M parameters as a text-only model, with 439M as a vision-language model, or with 577M as an audio-language model.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了EmbeddingGemma 2, 1, 1, 我们的模型可在https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/embeddinggemma上找到。 一个744M参数的多模式嵌入模型将文字、图像、视频和音频——以及任意的互页组合——映射到一个单一的统一嵌入空间(图1)。 嵌入Gemma 2将271M参数双向变压器主干线(包括嵌入式变压器)与167M参数视觉编码器和305M参数音频编码器结合. 模式编码器独立地将介质转换成进入共享变压器主干线的软符嵌入的序列,这意味着这些参数是模块化的: 嵌入Gemma 2也可以以271M参数作为文本唯一的模型运行,以439M作为视觉语言模型,或以577M作为音频语言模型.

blocks.en: The model builds on the architecture and weights from the capable Gemma 4 model family [ 13 ] and learns from the powerful Gemini Embedding 2 model [ 8 ] . Our training regime consists of three stages spanning various tasks, modalities, and domains, which results in a broadly capable model, excelling at problems like code search, visual question answering, video moment retrieval, audio classification, and much more. We separate text-only and multimodal training as a form of curriculum learning, and separate distillation from contrastive and regularization objectives in order to effectively learn an embedding space tailored to the model. For extreme resource-constrained settings, the model offers high-quality truncated embeddings and separate checkpoints adapted with quantization-aware training.
blocks.zh: 该模型以有能力的Gemma 4模型家族[13]的建筑和重量为基础,向强大的双子座嵌入2模型[8]学习. 我们的训练制度包括三个阶段, 包括各种任务、模式和领域, 形成了一个具有广泛能力的模式, 我们把只提供文本的培训与多模式培训分开,作为课程学习的一种形式,并将提炼与对比性和正规化目标分开,以便有效地学习适合模式的嵌入空间。 对于受资源限制的极端环境,该模式提供高质量的短插座和经过量化-认识训练的单独检查站。

blocks.en: We present ablation studies explaining our architectural and training choices. We find that simplifying per-layer embeddings to omit the dedicated lookup table not only reduces cost but improves performance; we present the effects of using different vision token budgets during training and inference, observing it only significantly affects tasks like document retrieval which require fine-grained visual understanding; we demonstrate the importance of co-training the vision encoder; we show the impact of finetuning with contrastive learning rather than distillation; and we confirm the value of native audio understanding over ASR.
blocks.zh: 我们提出各种研究,解释我们的建筑和培训选择。 我们发现,简化每个层次的嵌入以省略专用的检索表不仅会降低成本,而且会提高绩效;我们介绍在培训和推论期间使用不同视觉符号预算的效果,观察到它只会显著地影响诸如文件检索等需要精细视觉理解的任务;我们表明共同培训视觉编码器的重要性;我们显示与对比性学习进行微调而不是蒸馏的影响;我们确认本地音频理解相对于ASR的价值。

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate the model on seven major, comprehensive benchmark suites spanning text, code, image, video, document, speech, and sound inputs. EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier across benchmarks spanning all modalities ( Figure 2 ). Despite using fewer parameters for text than its predecessor and handling more modalities, it improves on both multilingual text and code benchmarks. On multimodal evals, EmbeddingGemma 2 often matches or exceeds the quality of specialized and multi-billion-parameter models.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用七套涵盖文本、代码、图像、视频、文件、言论和声音投入的综合性主要基准套件来评估模型。 嵌入Gemma 2建立了一个跨越所有模式的基准的新的Pareto边界(图2)。 尽管文本使用的参数比其前身少,而且处理的方式更多,但它改进了多语文文本和代码基准。 在多式电val上,EmbeddingGemma 2经常匹配或超过专门和数十亿参数模型的质量.

blocks.en: 2.2 Input
blocks.zh: 2.2 投入

blocks.en: In general, an input x x consists of an ordered sequence of M ≥ 1 M\geq 1 modality segments x = ( s 1 , s 2 , … , s M ) x=(s_{1},s_{2},\dots,s_{M}) , where each segment s m s_{m} belongs to one of four modalities: 1. Text is tokenized into N txt N_{\text{txt}} tokens which are mapped via the embedding table to a sequence of token embeddings: 𝐓 txt = ℰ ⁡ ( s m ) ∈ ℝ N txt × d M \mathbf{T}_{\text{txt}}=\mathcal{E}(s_{m})\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\text{txt}}\times d_{M}} . 2. Images are each processed by the vision encoder 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and spatially pooled to below a fixed budget of N vis N_{\text{vis}} soft tokens, 𝐓 vis ′ = 𝒱 ⁡ ( s m ) ∈ ℝ N vis × d V \mathbf{T}^{\prime}_{\text{vis}}=\mathcal{V}(s_{m})\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\text{vis}}\times d_{V}} . N vis N_{\text{vis}} defaults to 280 280 for images and 140 140 for video during training, but is configurable to 70 70 , 140 140 , 280 280 , 560 560 , or 1120 1120 at inference time—see how this impacts quality in Table 5 . These soft tokens are then projected by the vision adapter and wrapped with delimiter tokens: 𝐓 vis = <|SOI|> ⊕ ϕ vis ​ ( 𝐓 vis ′ ) ⊕ <|EOI|> ∈ ℝ ( N vis + 2 ) × d M \mathbf{T}_{\text{vis}}=\texttt{<|SOI|>}\oplus\phi_{\text{vis}}(\mathbf{T}^{\prime}_{\text{vis}})\oplus\texttt{<|EOI|>}\in\mathbb{R}^{(N_{\text{vis}}+2)\times d_{M}} . 3. Audio is processed in 40ms chunks with Mel filterbank inputs, producing 25 soft tokens per second of audio: 𝐓 aud ′ = 𝒜 ⁡ ( s m ) ∈ ℝ N aud × d A \mathbf{T}^{\prime}_{\text{aud}}=\mathcal{A}(s_{m})\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\text{aud}}\times d_{A}} . These are projected by the audio adapter and wrapped with different delimiter tokens to produce: 𝐓 aud = <|SOA|> ⊕ ϕ aud ​ ( 𝐓 aud ′ ) ⊕ <|EOA|> ∈ ℝ ( N aud + 2 ) × d M \mathbf{T}_{\text{aud}}=\texttt{<|SOA|>}\oplus\phi_{\text{aud}}(\mathbf{T}^{\prime}_{\text{aud}})\oplus\texttt{<|EOA|>}\in\mathbb{R}^{(N_{\text{aud}}+2)\times d_{M}} . 4. Video clips are typically sampled at 1 frame per second to begin. Then, for longer videos, frames are further sampled to fit a per-video frame budget N frm N_{\text{frm}} —this is sometimes via truncation, by selecting the first N frm N_{\text{frm}} frames, and sometimes via uniform sampling, by selecting N frm N_{\text{frm}} evenly spaced frames over the entire video. During our training and evaluations we use N frm = 32 N_{\text{frm}}=32 . Since each frame is processed by the vision encoder as an image, this results in up to N frm N_{\text{frm}} segments, each with at most N vis N_{\text{vis}} soft tokens and two image delimiter tokens. Optionally, frames can be interleaved with audio tokens from the video’s soundtrack, with each frame coming first and then the audio that follows it divided into 1-second segments. Usually, this corresponds to a single 1-second audio segment per frame, but if frames are truncated we might have multiple trailing audio segments, and if frames are uniformly sampled, we might have multiple audio segments between frames. blocks.en: The second loss is based on the global orthogonal regularizer (GOR) introduced in Zhang et al. [22] . The idea is to make the embeddings of a random pair of inputs have similar statistical properties (mean and second moment) as two points independently and uniformly sampled from the unit sphere. Following EmbeddingGemma 1 [ 23 ] , we use only the “second moment” term of the regularizer’s original definition, as we find this also sufficiently pushes the “mean” term towards its target value: ℒ S \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{S} = 1 B ⁡ ( B − 1 ) ​ ∑ 1 ≤ i ≠ j ≤ B ( 𝐪 i ⊤ ​ 𝐪 j ) 2 + 1 B ⁡ ( B − 1 ) ​ ∑ 1 ≤ i ≠ j ≤ B ( 𝐩 i + ⁣ ⊤ ​ 𝐩 j + ) 2 . \displaystyle=\frac{1}{B\,(B-1)}\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq B}(\mathbf{q}_{i}^{\top}\mathbf{q}_{j})^{2}+\,\frac{1}{B\,(B-1)}\sum_{1\leq i\neq j\leq B}(\mathbf{p}_{i}^{+\top}\mathbf{p}_{j}^{+})^{2}. (5) This loss encourages the model to produce embeddings that are spread out over the embedding space, to fully utilize its expressive power. Embedding spaces have been observed to form narrow cones [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , but there are theoretical and empirical benefits to isotropy [ 28 , 29 ] , including performance in downstream tasks. Note that pushing random pairs toward orthogonality complements the squared-hinge penalties above to make scores more calibrated and interpretable. Enforcing isotropy also aims to ensure that a) the model is robust to weight and embedding quantization, and b) the embeddings can be retrieved efficiently in vector databases using approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) algorithms.

Unlike Kim et al. [30] , which applies a projection layer to distill from a model with different dimensionality, we instead make use of Gemini Embedding 2’s support for lower dimensions and simply truncate the teacher embeddings. As in Schechter Vera et al. blocks.en: 2.4 Recipe
blocks.zh: 2.4 食谱

blocks.en: EmbeddingGemma 2 builds directly on Gemma 4’s extensive world knowledge and capabilities. The backbone is adapted from a pretrained Gemma 4 decoder-only model, switching the causal attention mask to bidirectional attention to enable fully contextual token representations [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 8 ] . We omit explicit adaptation stages for bidirectional attention [ 23 , 37 ] , which can be costly and have been shown to be unnecessary for learning expressive representations [ 23 , 38 ] . We also remove the PLE-specific token lookup table (detailed in Table 2 ), and add mean pooling [ 39 , 23 ] , a linear projection, and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalization after the transformer. The vision encoder is initialized with the smaller Gemma 4 vision encoder and further trained in the two multimodal stages, which we show in Section 3 to be critical for quality. The audio encoder is bit-identical to that in the Gemma 4 E2B and E4B models [ 13 ] and kept frozen during training.
blocks.zh: Gemma 2直接依靠Gemma 4的广泛世界知识和能力。 骨干由经过预先训练的Gemma 4解码器专用模型改编而成,将因果关注面具切换为双向关注,使完全上下文的符号表达[34,35,36,8]. 我们省略了双向关注的明确适应阶段[23,37],这些阶段可能代价高昂,而且已经证明对于学习表达性表述[23,38]是不必要的. 我们还删除了 PLE 专用的代号查询表(详见表2),并添加平均集合[39,23],线性预测,以及l 2\ell\2} - 变压器后正常化。 视觉编码器以较小的Gemma 4视觉编码器初始化,并在两个多式联运阶段接受进一步培训,我们在第三节中表示这对质量至关重要。 音频编码器与Gemma 4 E2B和E4B型号[13]中的编码是比特-等同的,并在训练期间保持冷冻.

blocks.en: We then train EmbeddingGemma 2 on a mixture of embedding tasks spanning various modalities and task types. In total, the model sees approximately 2.9T tokens, of which ∼ \sim 300B are seen during text pre-finetuning, ∼ \sim 2T during multimodal pre-finetuning, and ∼ \sim 600B during multimodal finetuning.
blocks.zh: 然后我们训练EmbeddingGemma 2, 混合嵌入任务 跨越各种模式和任务类型。 该型号总共看到约2.9T令牌,其中\\sim 300B在文本预调时看到,\sim 2T在多式联运预调时看到,\sim 600B在多式联运微调时看到.

blocks.en: We begin with a pre-finetuning stage like the one in Schechter Vera et al. [23] . This entails a large-scale unsupervised data mixture of query-target pairs from question answering, sentence similarity, code retrieval, and web search tasks using various languages. As before, we opt for a larger batch size both to stabilize the gradient and to provide more (in-batch) negatives for each input example. In this stage we almost exclusively employ distillation loss, with only an additional contrastive loss using a small weight. Here, as with subsequent stages, tasks are sampled at pre-determined, empirically defined rates. We found the inclusion of a text-only stage important for the model’s final text quality. This stage can be seen as a form of curriculum learning, or as an implicit warm-up for the bidirectional attention, similar to BehnamGhader et al. [37] ; it has also been shown to enhance the discriminability of both text and non-text embeddings [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们从一个预测阶段开始 就像Schechter Vera等人的阶段 [23] (中文(简体) ). 这就需要从问答,句子相似性,代码检索,以及使用各种语言的网络搜索任务中,将查询-目标对进行大规模无监督的数据混合. 和以前一样,我们选择更大的批量尺寸,既稳定梯度,又为每个输入例提供更多的(插件中)负数. 在这个阶段,我们几乎完全使用蒸馏损失,而只是使用很小的重量进行额外的对比性损失。 在这里,与以后各阶段一样,按照预先确定、经验确定的费率对任务进行抽样。 我们认为,只列入一个文本阶段对模型的最后文本质量很重要。 这个阶段可以看作是课程学习的一种形式,也可以看作是双向关注的隐含的热身,类似于BehnamGhader等人. [37];它也证明可以提高文本和非文本嵌入的区别性[10].

blocks.en: We then continue with pre-finetuning, but with a new mixture which also includes inputs with images, audio, video, and documents across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal tasks, most with additional hard negatives. The text tasks in this stage and the next include those described in the finetuning stage of Schechter Vera et al. [23] , which aim to cover task diversity, language diversity, and coding capability. In this stage, we exclusively employ distillation loss, to inherit the teacher’s ability to map diverse and mixed modalities into a shared semantic space. We continue training with larger batch sizes and larger learning rates, but train for twice as many steps as in text pre-finetuning to cover the expanded multimodal training set.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们继续进行预先调整,但采用新的混合方式,其中也包括有图像、音频、视频和文件的输入,它们跨越单式、跨式和混合式任务,大多数任务带有额外的硬底。 这一阶段和下一个阶段的文字任务包括Schechter Vera等人[23]的微调阶段描述的文字任务,其目的是涵盖任务多样性,语言多样性,以及编码能力. 在这个阶段,我们完全利用蒸馏损失,继承教师将多种和混合模式映射到共同语义空间的能力。 我们继续以更大的批量规模和较高的学习率进行培训,但培训步骤是文本预编培训的两倍,以涵盖扩大的多式联运培训。

blocks.en: In the finetuning stage, we completely replace distillation with contrastive loss. This allows the model to learn a tailored embedding space independent of its teacher, as the teacher’s embedding space is not optimized for the student’s architecture, size, and MRL sub-dimensions. We also add other losses which aim to shape the final embedding space to have desirable properties: spread-out regularizer and MRL losses. As in Schechter Vera et al. [23] , we transition to smaller learning rates and batch sizes, and shift towards higher-quality, task-specific datasets, such as tool retrieval, audio captioning, video ranking, medical imaging, visual product search, cropped-object retrieval, and academic question-answering.
blocks.zh: 在微调阶段,我们完全用对比性损失取代蒸馏. 这使得模型能够学习一个独立于老师的特制嵌入空间,因为老师的嵌入空间并没有为学生的建筑,体积,以及MRL子底部进行优化. 我们还增加了其他损失,这些损失旨在塑造最终嵌入空间,使其具有可取的特性:散射常态器和MRL损失。 如Schechter Vera等人[23],我们向较小的学习率和批量规模过渡,转向质量更高的、针对特定任务的数据集,如工具检索、音频字幕、视频排名、医疗成像、视觉产品搜索、收割对象检索和学术问答。

blocks.en: Finally, we combine checkpoints from our finetuning run by averaging their weights, to improve our final model’s quality and robustness. Rather than running multiple finetuning jobs, either with different data mixture rates [ 23 ] or with different hyperparameters [ 40 ] , we merge checkpoints along a single finetuning trajectory [ 41 ] . Specifically, we compute an unweighted average between the final checkpoint from the finetuning run and a significantly earlier checkpoint from the same run. Like Wortsman et al. [42] , which similarly merges pretrained and finetuned checkpoints, we found that this helps mitigate degradation on tasks that overfit during finetuning, while also further improving performance on tasks that already benefited from finetuning.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们通过平均重量的微调将检查站结合起来,以提高我们最后模式的质量和稳健性。 我们不是用不同的数据混合率[23]或不同的超参数[40]进行多重微调,而是沿着单一微调轨迹合并检查站[41]。 具体地说,我们从微调运行中计算出最后检查站与从同一运行运行中计算出一个大大提前的检查站之间的未加权平均数。 正如Wortsman等人[42]同样合并了经过预先训练和微调的检查站一样,我们发现,这有助于减轻在微调时过度适应的任务的退化,同时进一步改善已经受益于微调的任务的绩效。

blocks.en: We additionally provide quantized versions of EmbeddingGemma 2 in different quantization configurations. We provide checkpoints with two types of weight representations for the backbone: int4 per-block (Q4_0) and int4 per-channel (Q4_C). For the modality encoders, we follow the quantization schemes used in Gemma 4: the vision encoder uses 8-bit precision for both weights and activations (W8A8), and the audio encoder uses 8-bit activation precision and {2, 4, 8}-bit weight precision varying by layer cluster.
blocks.zh: 我们额外提供了EmbeddingGemma 2在不同的量化配置中的量化版本. 我们向检查站提供两种类型的骨干重量表示:每块整数(Q4_0)和每道整数(Q4_C)。 对于模式编码器,我们遵循Gemma 4中使用的量子化方案:视觉编码器使用8位精度进行权重和激活(W8A8),音频编码器使用8位精度和{2,4,8}-位精度,按层组不同.

blocks.en: We apply quantization-aware training [ 43 , QAT,] to both the backbone and vision encoder to minimize quality degradation (the audio encoder is taken directly from Gemma 4). However, instead of applying QAT directly in the finetuning stage as in Schechter Vera et al. [23] , we introduce a separate post-merging tail-patch stage in which we distill (and initialize) our QAT checkpoint from the frozen float checkpoint [ 44 ] . This allows for a more resource-efficient QAT stage and narrows the gap in quality between the float and quantized checkpoints for some evaluations, notably MTEB(English, v2). Table 1 shows the quality is comparable between our quantized checkpoints and our raw checkpoint (evaluated at half-precision bfloat16 weights). With Q4_C quantization, the peak on-device memory footprint during inference (including runtime compilation overhead) on a Google Pixel 11 Pro is reduced to 191 MB for text-only, 447 MB for text and vision, and 567 MB for the full multimodal model.
blocks.zh: 我们对骨干和视觉编码器都采用量化-认知训练[43,QAT,],以尽量减少质量退化(音频编码器直接取自Gemma 4). 然而,我们并没有像Schechter Vera等人[23]中那样在微调阶段直接应用QAT,而是引入一个单独的后复刻尾巴-patch阶段,在这个阶段中,我们从被冻结的浮标检查站提炼(并初始化)我们的QAT检查站[44]. 这使得QAT阶段资源效率更高,并缩小了一些评价,特别是MTEB(英语,v2)的浮点和量化检查站在质量方面的差距. 表1显示,我们量化的检查站和原始检查站(按半精度bfloat16重量评估)的质量是相当的。 随着Q4_C的量化,Google像素11 Pro的推论(包括运行时编译高空)期间的顶峰值在断层内存足迹被减少到仅限文本的191 MB,文本和视觉的447 MB,以及全多模式模型的567 MB.

blocks.en: 3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 3 读物研究

blocks.en: We analyze some key design choices to better understand how they contributed to EmbeddingGemma 2’s ability to produce high-quality embeddings across modalities, domains, and task types. Baseline and ablation models use an intermediate recipe and so numbers are not representative of the final model. Unless otherwise stated, the experiments run finetuning on a pre-finetuned model. We evaluate the models on MMEB-v2 as it covers various tasks involving combinations of text, images, documents, and video, excluding only audio.
blocks.zh: 我们分析一些关键的设计选择,以更好地了解它们如何促进EnbeddingGemma 2在模式、领域和任务类型方面生产高质量嵌入的能力。 基线模型和衰减模型使用中间配方,因此数字不能代表最终模型。 除非另有说明,这些实验对预置模型进行了微调。 我们评价MMEB-v2上的模型,因为它包括各种任务,涉及文本、图像、文件和视频的组合,但不包括音频。

blocks.en: 3.1 Per-Layer Embeddings Table
blocks.zh: 3.1 每层嵌入量表

blocks.en: Table 2 : Results with and without a dedicated Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) lookup table.
blocks.zh: 表2:有和没有专门的每个莱尔嵌入(PLE)检索表的结果。

blocks.en: Gemma 3n and Gemma 4 incorporate Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) to inject token-level information into intermediate transformer layers. Specifically, they combine a learned projection of the main token embedding with an additional dedicated PLE lookup table. However, a dedicated PLE lookup table provides no direct signals for non-text modalities and consumes additional memory.
blocks.zh: Gemma 3n和Gemma 4结合了Per-Layer Embeddings(PLE),将符号级信息注入中间变压器层. 具体来说,它们结合了对主符嵌入的学习预测和额外的专用PLE检索表. 然而,专用的PLE查询表并没有为非文本模式提供直接信号,消耗额外的内存.

blocks.en: We utilize only the projection, as described in detail in Section 2.1 ; this way, we continue providing per-layer inputs but can omit the lookup table. We compare our approach to PLE with a lookup table in Table 2 . Removing the dedicated PLE table not only reduces parameter overhead, but also strengthens performance across all three categories (notably +0.69 on Video and +0.61 on VisDoc), confirming that deriving per-layer inputs solely from the shared d M d_{M} -dimensional embedding space improves multimodal representation quality. We also found similar improvements in text-only evaluations, where one might expect the lookup table to help the most.
blocks.zh: 我们只利用第2.1节详细描述的预测;这样,我们继续提供每层投入,但可以省略检索表。 比较表2中的检索表。 删除专用的PLE表不仅会减少参数的间接费用,而且会加强所有三个类别的性能(主要是视频上+0.69和VisDoc上+0.61),证实仅仅从共享的d M d_{M}-维嵌入空间中得出每层输入,可以提高多式联运的表达质量。 我们还发现,在仅文本评价方面也有类似的改进,人们可能期望检索表最有帮助。

blocks.en: 3.2 Finetuning Stage
blocks.zh: 3.2 微调阶段

blocks.en: Table 3 : Results of continued distillation versus adding a finetuning stage with contrastive learning.
blocks.zh: 表 3:继续蒸馏的结果与增加与对比性学习的微调阶段。

blocks.en: We investigate whether the gains from our finetuning stage are truly driven by a difference in recipe or merely by extending training. Starting from the multimodal pre-finetuning checkpoint, we compare running the multimodal finetuning stage against continuing distillation for an approximately compute-equivalent duration (the same number of steps, but with larger batch sizes on distillation). Table 3 shows that while distillation plateaus, transitioning to the finetuning recipe with contrastive and spread-out objectives boosts performance significantly for image and video tasks while yielding similar results for visual documents. This demonstrates that the finetuning stage enables the model to move beyond imitating its teacher and learn a better-optimized representation space.
blocks.zh: 我们调查的是,我们微调阶段的成果是否真正是由食谱的不同驱动,还是仅仅是通过扩大培训。 从多式联运预精细检查点开始,我们将运行多式联运微调阶段与大约计算等效的连续蒸馏(相同步骤的数目,但蒸馏时的批量尺寸较大)进行比较。 表3显示,在蒸馏高原的同时,向具有对比性和分散性目标的微调配方过渡可大大提高图像和视频任务的业绩,同时对视觉文件产生类似的结果。 这表明,微调阶段使模型能够超越模仿其老师和学习更优化的表达空间。

blocks.en: 3.3 Vision Encoder Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 愿景编码器培训

blocks.en: Table 4 : Results with trainable and frozen vision encoder.
blocks.zh: 表4:可训练和冷冻视力编码器的结果。

blocks.en: MLLMs often keep modality encoders frozen throughout training [ 45 , 46 , 47 , 13 ] . This strategy is also popular in recent multimodal embedding models [ 48 , 9 , 49 , 4 ] . For MLLMs, ablations investigating whether freezing or unfreezing the vision encoder is better are mixed [ 50 , 45 , 51 ] . However, we show in Table 4 that, though the Gemma 4 vision encoder is quite strong by itself, training the vision encoder greatly improves performance of the resulting embeddings on multimodal tasks. Analogous gains are likely possible by further training the audio encoder. Note that both runs here start with a text pre-finetuning checkpoint and run multimodal pre-finetuning, to ensure the vision encoder has not already been updated prior to either experiment.
blocks.zh: MLLMs在训练过程中经常将模式编码器冻结[45,46,47,13]. 这一战略在近期的多式联运嵌入模型中也很受欢迎[48、9、49、4]。 对 MLLMs 来说,调查是否冷冻或解冻视觉编码器更好是混合的[50,45,51]. 然而,我们在表4中显示,虽然Gemma 4的视觉编码器本身相当强大,但培训视觉编码器大大提高了由此产生的嵌入多式联运任务的性能。 通过进一步培训音频编码器,有可能取得类似的收益。 请注意,这两处都从文本预调值检查点开始运行,并运行多式预调值,以确保在两个试验之前都没有更新视觉编码器。

blocks.en: Some MLLMs manage to additionally keep the backbone frozen [ 52 ] . Hönicke et al. [49] similarly joins a backbone text embedding model with modality encoders, keeping each of them frozen. This prevents users from having to backfill embedding databases created with the text embedding model; however, it is possible to translate embeddings from one model’s space to another [ 53 ] , even without access to paired data or to the original models [ 54 ] . Moreover, freezing a text-only backbone empirically seems to limit its ability to understand multimodal inputs, and indeed many of the strongest multimodal embedding models finetune the backbone alongside the modality encoders [ 12 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 一些MLLMs设法使骨干进一步冻结 [52]. Hönicke等人著. [49] 类似地加入一个主干文本嵌入模型与模式编码器,使其各自保持冻结. 这样,用户就不必回填使用文本嵌入模型创建的嵌入数据库;然而,即使无法访问成对数据或原始模型[54],也可以将嵌入从一个模型的空间翻译到另一个[53]. 此外,从经验上看,冻结一个仅文本主干线似乎限制了它理解多式联运投入的能力,事实上,许多最强的多式联运嵌入模型将主干线与模式编码器一起微调[12、10]。

blocks.en: 3.4 Vision Token Budgets
blocks.zh: 3.4 远景预算

blocks.en: Table 5 : Results with different vision token budgets (max soft tokens per image or video frame) at train and inference time. Evaluation uses a single budget for all tasks. Top: Inference-time scaling of a model trained with 280 tokens per image and 140 per video frame. Bottom: Train-time scaling with 70 vs. 140 tokens per video frame. The two experiments use different intermediate recipes.
blocks.zh: 表5:列车和推导时间不同视标预算(每个图像或视频框最大软符)的结果。 评价对所有任务采用单一预算。 顶部 : 一个模型的推论时间缩放经过培训,每个图像有280个符号,每个视频框有140个符号. 底部:列车时间缩放,每帧70对140令牌. 这两个实验使用不同的中间配方.

blocks.en: We train EmbeddingGemma 2 with a budget of 280 vision tokens for images and 140 tokens per frame for videos, but the underlying Gemma 4 vision encoder supports budgets from 70 to 1120 tokens. In Table 5 (top), we show the effect of using different vision token budgets at inference time using an intermediate checkpoint trained with 280 tokens per image and 140 per frame. Overall performance scales monotonically, with some distinct modality-specific behaviors. Visual document tasks are highly sensitive to fine-grained details and continue to improve greatly past the training budget; image quality in aggregate begins to saturate at the 280-token budget (despite continued gains on several individual tasks); and video performance actually degrades between 280 tokens and 560, likely because the excessive sequence lengths dilute attention and mean-pooled representations.
blocks.zh: 我们训练EmbeddingGemma 2,预算为图像280个视觉符号,视频每个帧140个符号,但Gemma 4的视觉编码器支持预算从70个符号到1120个符号. 在表5(顶部)中,我们显示在推断时使用不同视觉符号预算的效果,即使用一个中间检查站,每幅图像有280个符号,每帧140个。 总体性能尺度单调,具有一些独特的模式特定行为. 视觉文件任务对细微细节高度敏感,并继续大大改进训练预算;在280个托肯预算中,图像质量总和开始饱和(尽管在若干个别任务上不断有所收获);视频性能实际上在280个令牌和560个之间下降,可能是因为过多的序列长度淡化了注意力和平均集合的表示.

blocks.en: Additionally, we compare models trained with 70 vs. 140 per-frame video tokens ( Table 5 , bottom) to see whether training with a smaller vision budget could improve quality when using smaller vision budgets at inference time, for resource-constrained deployment. When evaluated with 70 tokens, training with 70 video tokens improves performance on video tasks, as the model is directly exposed to 70-token frames during training. But this advantage does not hold for image or visual document tasks, which drop in quality. This is likely because a) single-image tasks, which continue to be trained with 280 tokens, are treated as a separate modality and do not benefit from seeing 70-token video frames; and b) coarser video representations discard spatial details that otherwise transfer to stronger general visual representations. The latter is further supported when evaluating with 140 tokens, where training with 70 video tokens degrades performance even more, and across modalities—this makes the 140-token video budget preferable across both evaluation regimes. More gains are likely possible by increasing train-time budgets, but with seemingly diminishing returns and at a significant computational cost.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们将培训的模型与70对140的每帧录像信使(表5,底部)进行比较,以确定在推断时使用较小的远景预算进行资源限制的部署时,具有较小远景预算的培训能否提高质量。 在使用70个符号进行评价时,使用70个视频符号的培训会提高视频任务的表现,因为模型在训练期间直接暴露在70个托肯框上. 但这种优势并不具备图像或视觉文档任务,这些任务质量下降. 这可能是因为(a) 继续接受280个符号训练的单像任务被作为单独的模式对待,无法从70个托起的视频帧中获利;和(b) 较紧的视频表示器丢弃了空间细节,而这些细节本来会转移到更强大的一般视觉表现. 在用140个标语进行评价时,后者得到了进一步支持,因为用70个标语进行的培训使业绩更加低下,而且不同模式之间,这使得140个标语的录像预算在两个评价制度中都更为可取。 增加培训时间预算,但收益似乎减少,计算成本很高,可能增加收益。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate EmbeddingGemma 2 on a comprehensive set of benchmarks across diverse modalities, task types, domains, and languages. Specifically, we report numbers from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark [ 55 , 56 , MTEB,] for natural language and code; the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark v2 [ 57 , MMEB-v2,] and Massive Image Embedding Benchmark [ 58 , MIEB-lite,] for image, video, and visual documents; and the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark and Massive Audio Embedding Benchmark for speech, music, and environmental sounds [ 59 , 60 , MSEB and MAEB,] . We provide a summary of our results in Table 6 and dive into each benchmark in more detail below.
blocks.zh: 我们评价EmbeddingGemma 2的一套全面基准,涵盖不同模式、任务类型、领域和语言。 具体地说,我们报告的数字来自:自然语言和编码的大规模文字嵌入基准[55、56、MTEB];图像、视频和视觉文件的大规模多式联运嵌入基准v2[57、MMEB-v2]和大规模图像嵌入基准[58、MIEB-lite];语音、音乐和环境声音的大规模声音嵌入基准和大规模音频嵌入基准[59、60、MSEB和MAEB]。 我们在表6中概述了我们的成果,并在下文更详细地介绍每个基准。

blocks.en: 4.1 Methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 方法

blocks.en: We select as baselines the top-ranked models on each benchmark, including both modality specialists and general-purpose embedding models which support all evaluated modalities. For MTEB, MAEB, and MIEB(lite), we compare against models under 1B parameters; for MMEB-v2, we include models under 2B parameters, as small models are scarce. Because it is one of the most directly comparable models, we evaluate jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano on MMEB-v2 using its official implementation and verify that, on the subset reported in Hönicke et al. [49] , our reproduced score is slightly higher. All other baseline scores are sourced from public leaderboards. We restrict our analysis to single-vector models, given the disparity in storage and latency costs with multi-vector models, and omit models trained on > > 25% of the evaluation data, as data contamination undermines the evaluation’s validity.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个基准上选择排名最高的模型作为基线,包括模式专家和支持所有评估模式的通用嵌入模型。 对于MTEB,MAEB,和MIEB(lite),我们比较了1B参数下的模型;对于MMEB-v2,我们包括2B参数下的模型,因为小模型稀缺. 由于这是最直接可比较的模型之一,我们利用MMEB-v2的正式执行来评价Jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano,并核实Hönicke等人报告的子集。 [49],我们复制的分数略高. 所有其他基线分数都来自公共领导板. 鉴于储存成本和耐用成本与多载体模型的差别,我们只将分析局限于单载体模型,省略了经过 > 25%评价数据培训的模型,因为数据污染损害了评价的有效性。

blocks.en: We evaluate EmbeddingGemma 2 using half-precision weights (bfloat16) and the seven types of task instructions detailed in Appendix A . We use different sequence lengths depending on the modality and task type. For visual inputs, we use up to N frm = 32 N_{\text{frm}}=32 frames per video at 140 vision tokens per frame and 280 vision tokens per image to reflect realistic model use, though we note that higher vision token budgets could yield further gains, particularly for visual documents ( Table 5 ). Because most baseline models support limited modalities, we count only the parameters EmbeddingGemma 2 utilized for each benchmark; other models’ parameter counts are as reported on respective leaderboards.
blocks.zh: 我们使用半精度重量(bfloat16)和附录A详述的七类任务说明来评价EmbeddingGemma 2。 我们根据方式和任务类型使用不同的序列长度. 对于视觉输入,我们使用最多为N frm=32 NQQText{frm}}=32帧的每段视频,每帧140个视觉符号,每个图像280个视觉符号,以反映现实的模型用途,尽管我们注意到较高的视觉符号预算可以产生进一步的收益,特别是视觉文件(表5)。 由于大多数基准模型支持有限的模式,我们只计算每个基准所使用的参数EmbeddingGemma 2;其他模型的参数计数如各领导板上所报告的那样。

blocks.en: 4.2 Text
blocks.zh: 4.2 案文

blocks.en: The MTEB suite consists of a massive collection of individual, quality-controlled evaluation tasks. Together, the 162 tasks cover 250+ natural languages and 14+ programming languages, 20 domains (e.g. legal, medical, news, programming, web), and 10 task types: bitext mining, classification, clustering, instruction retrieval, multilabel classification, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic text similarity (STS), and summarization.
blocks.zh: MTEB套件包括大量收集个人,质量控制的评价任务. 162项任务共涵盖250+自然语言和14+编程语言,20个域(如法律,医学,新闻,编程,网络),以及10项任务类型:比特ext挖掘,分类,集群,指令检索,多标签分类,对子分类,重排,检索,语义文本相似性(STS)和总结.

blocks.en: Despite having fewer text parameters and sharing its representation space with vision and audio, EmbeddingGemma 2 improves over its predecessor on multilingual text (driven by gains in bitext mining and classification). On English, the model sees a modest regression. Only two smaller models surpass it on multilingual text, and one on English, but they are all trained as specialist text models ( Appendix B ). The model presents competitive text scores which outperform much larger models.
blocks.zh: 尽管文本参数较少,并用视觉和音频分享其代表空间,EmbeddingGemma 2在多语种文本上比前作有所改进(由位图挖掘和分类的增益推动). 在英语上,模型看到了一个适度的回归. 只有两个较小的模型在多语种文本上超过了它,一个在英语上超过了它,但他们都作为专家文本模型接受了培训(附录B)。 该模型提出了具有竞争力的文本评分,这些评分优于更大的模型。

blocks.en: On code ( Table 7 ), EmbeddingGemma 2’s performance is stellar, establishing a new Pareto frontier. It outperforms every sub-4B model on the leaderboard and even comes within 2 points of the 28 × \times larger frontrunner. In all three benchmarks, the model’s truncated representations degrade minimally, especially down to 256 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 在代码(表7)上,EmbeddingGemma 2的性能是显赫的,建立了一个新的Pareto前沿. 它的性能超过了领导板上的每一个子-4B模型,甚至出现在28×\时较大的前卫的2点之内. 在所有三项基准中,该模型的短幅表示最小地下降,特别是降至256个维度。

blocks.en: 4.3 Vision
blocks.zh: 4.3 愿景

blocks.en: MMEB-v2 spans 78 tasks across image, video, and visual document modalities, the latter of which includes PDFs, slides, and charts. These include retrieval, classification, question answering, visual grounding, and moment retrieval. MIEB(lite) complements this with linear-probe classification, clustering, multiple choice, compositionality, and visual semantic text similarity. They both implicitly evaluate countless visual skills like object detection, counting, optical character recognition, and temporal reasoning. They also cover various permutations of cross-modal and mixed-modal situations.
blocks.zh: MMEB-v2跨度78项任务,跨越图像,视频和视觉文档模式,后者包括PDF,幻灯片和图表. 其中包括检索、分类、问答、目视定位和瞬间检索。 MIEB(lite)以线性-概率分类,集群,多重选择,组成性,以及视觉语义文本的相似性来补充这一点. 他们都含蓄地评价无数的视觉技能,如物体检测,计数,光学字符识别,以及时间推理. 它们也涵盖各种跨模式和混合模式情形。

blocks.en: EmbeddingGemma 2 is the smallest model on the MMEB-v2 leaderboard ( Table 8 ). It excels especially at classification and retrieval, but provides strong scores across the board—its overall score is exceeded only by models around 2B parameters. It also outperforms various recent models including vision-language specialists with more than 8B parameters. On MIEB(lite), only two models beat EmbeddingGemma 2, and they have well over 4B parameters. Compared to top models under 1B parameters ( Table 9 ), EmbeddingGemma 2 sets the state of the art on both aggregate metrics by a wide margin (+7.9 Task, +12.2 Type). It also offers remarkable improvements in nearly all task types, notably multilingual visual STS (+22.8) and multilingual retrieval (+12.5). Even at 128 dimensions, the model outperforms every other sub-1B model at full dimensionality.
blocks.zh: 嵌入Gemma 2是MMEB-v2引导板上最小的模型(表8). 它特别在分类和检索方面表现优异,但提供全面的强分——它的总分只被大约2B参数的模型所超越。 它还超越了最近的各种模型,包括具有8B以上参数的视觉语言专家。 在MIEB(lite)上,只有两个型号击败了EmbeddingGemma 2,它们拥有远超4B参数. 与1B参数下的顶级模型(表9)相比,EmbeddingGemma 2以宽比(+7.9 Task,+12.2 Type)设定了两个汇总度量的状态. 它还为几乎所有任务类型提供了显著改进,特别是多语种视觉STS(+22.8)和多语种检索(+12.5)。 即使在128维度时,模型在全维度上也超越了所有其他的子-1B模型.

blocks.en: MAEB includes 30 tasks encompassing five acoustic domains: speech, music, environmental, bioacoustics, and emotion. These are spread across unimodal and cross-modal tasks within retrieval, reranking, clustering, and multiple types of classification. MSEB(Retrieval) contributes a focus on multilingual speech understanding. It evaluates the model’s ability to retrieve a text passage from a spoken query, both in the same language and across languages, with a total of 26 languages and regional locales.
blocks.zh: MAEB包括30项任务,包括五个声学领域:语音,音乐,环境,生物声学,和情感. 这些工作分布在回收、重新排位、集群和多种分类类型的单式和跨式任务之间。 MSEB(检索)有助于注重多语种语音理解。 它评估了该模型从同一种语言和跨语言的口语查询中检索文本段落的能力,共有26种语言和区域语言。

blocks.en: On MAEB, EmbeddingGemma 2 again sets a new frontier for efficiency. Notably, among sub-1B models, it achieves state-of-the-art scores on any-to-any retrieval and audio classification ( Table 10 ), as well as on about a third of all individual tasks. It is also state-of-the-art among models of all sizes for classification of audio pairs and a sixth of all individual tasks. Its mean task score is only about 0.2 points away from the best model under 1B parameters, and about 3.5 points away from the highest-scoring model overall. Even its 128-dimensional embeddings beat every other sub-1B model.
blocks.zh: 在MAEB上,EmbeddingGemma 2再次为效率开辟了新的前沿. 值得注意的是,在子-1B模型中,它在任何检索和音频分类(表10)以及大约三分之一的单个任务上都取得了最先进的分数。 它也是所有大小模型中用于音频配对分类的最先进的,也是所有单个任务的第六位. 其平均任务分数仅与1B参数下的最佳模型相距约0.2分,与总得分最高的模型相距约3.5分. 即使是它的128维嵌入也击败了所有其他的子-1B模型.

blocks.en: On average, the model surpasses various audio-text specialists, but there is an interesting specialization divide between them. While EmbeddingGemma 2 does beat specialists like CLAP at non-speech tasks like clustering vehicle sounds ( VehicleSoundClustering ), these models still outperform in tasks like audio captioning ( ClothoT2ARetrieval ). In speech tasks, EmbeddingGemma 2 sets the state of the art even in tasks with multiple languages ( FleursT2ARetrieval ) and singing ( JamAltLyricA2TRetrieval ). But it sometimes struggles at zero-shot tasks with a paralinguistic focus, despite understanding the acoustics deep down. For example, it struggles tremendously at clustering speakers by gender ( VoxPopuliGenderClustering : 0.40), but recovers quickly when doing the same task with a linear probe ( IEMOCAPGender : 66.40). This indicates the model’s speech representations are dominated by semantics, desirably avoiding biases such as speaker demographic while retaining paralinguistic and acoustic attributes for extraction when needed.
blocks.zh: 平均来说,该模型超过了各种音频文本专家,但是他们之间存在有趣的专业化鸿沟. 虽然EmbeddingGemma 2在编组车辆声音(VivesSoundClustering )等非语音任务上确实比CLAP这样的专家要好,但这些模型在音频字幕(ClothoT2ARetrieval )等任务上仍然表现优异. 在语音任务中,EmbeddingGemma 2即使以多种语言的任务(FleursT2ARetrieval)和唱歌(JamAltLyricA2TRetrieval)设定了艺术状态. 但是,它有时在零射任务中以偏执语的焦点而挣扎,尽管深处理解声学. 例如,它十分努力地将发言者按照性别分组(VoxPopuli GenderClusation: 0.40),但在用线性探测器完成同样任务时迅速恢复(IEMOCAP Gender: 66.40)。 这表明模型的语音表述以语义学为主,希望避免诸如说者人口统计等偏见,同时在必要时保留准语言和声学属性供提取。

blocks.en: The model’s excellence on spoken language is further underscored on MSEB. Even when using ASR and text embeddings, EmbeddingGemma 2 greatly outperforms EmbeddingGemma 1, indicating the strength persists throughout modalities ( Table 11 ). Encoding audio natively yields another even larger improvement. Instead of suffering from transcription errors from accents, homophones, or artifacts, native audio inputs preserve these signals and let the model take them into account. As a result, even the 256-dimensional embeddings greatly outperform the full-dimension ASR embeddings.
blocks.zh: MSEB进一步强调了该模式在口语方面的优秀表现。 即使在使用ASR和文本嵌入时,EmbeddingGemma 2的表现也大大超过EmbeddingGemma 1,表明强度在整个模式中持续存在(表11). 本地编码音频又产生更大的改进。 土生土长的音频输入没有受到口音,同声器或文物的抄写错误的困扰,而是保留这些信号,让模型加以考虑. 因此,即使是256维的嵌入也大大超过了全分化ASR嵌入.

blocks.en: 5 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 未来工作

blocks.en: Our work points to several concrete directions for future research. EmbeddingGemma 2 supports long sequences and variable vision token budgets, but further extending context length, for example via content-aware methods, could enable direct indexing of full-length media, improve performance on long-horizon tasks, and support novel agentic memory systems. Innovations such as encoder-free architectures could enable both quality improvements and further reductions in memory footprint and latency. Changes in training paradigms like the introduction of end-to-end RAG training present another opportunity to further optimize embedding models for downstream use. As interleaved all-to-all multimodal search becomes more prevalent, evaluation frameworks that represent novel use cases will become more important.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作指明了未来研究的几个具体方向。 EmbeddingGemma 2支持长序和可变的视觉符号预算,但通过内容感知方法等进一步扩展上下文长度,可以直接对全长介质进行索引,改善长视任务的表现,支持新颖的代理记忆系统. 无编码架构等创新既能提高质量,又能进一步减少记忆足迹和耐久性。 培训模式的改变,例如引进端到端RAG培训,为进一步优化嵌入模式供下游使用提供了又一次机会. 随着全方位互换的多式联运搜索越来越普遍,代表新用途案例的评价框架将变得更加重要。

blocks.en: At the same time, EmbeddingGemma 2’s utility extends far beyond single-vector retrieval, serving as a general-purpose multimodal encoder. Operating on its final embeddings or unpooled token representations, the model can be adapted into (or may even excel zero-shot as) a general decision model [ 61 , 62 , 63 , 64 ] , model router [ 65 ] , reward model [ 66 ] , reranker [ 67 ] , speech-to-text model [ 68 , 69 ] , late interaction retriever [ 70 , 71 , 72 ] , and much more.
blocks.zh: 同时,EmbeddingGemma 2的效用远远超出了单载体检索的范围,成为通用的多式联运编码器. 运行于其最终嵌入式或未拼接的符号表示式上,该模型可以被改编成(甚至可能优于零射)一般决定模型[61,62,63,64],模型路由器[65],奖励模型[66],重新排行榜[67],语音对文本模型[68,69],后期交互检索器[70,71,72],以及更多.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: EmbeddingGemma 2 builds on its predecessor with a smaller, stronger backbone and native multimodal capabilities. Our approach introduces improvements like simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with both modality and objective progression. This enables EmbeddingGemma 2 to set a new Pareto frontier across text, vision, and audio benchmarks, often surpassing specialist and general-purpose models several times larger. With native support for weight quantization, embedding truncation, and modular encoder loading, EmbeddingGemma 2 makes high-quality multimodal embeddings practical in resource-constrained and on-device settings. We release EmbeddingGemma 2 checkpoints to the community to accelerate research and development, for both off-the-shelf use and as a foundational multimodal encoder.
blocks.zh: 嵌入Gemma 2以其前身为基础,具有较小、更强大的骨干和本土多式联运能力。 我们的方法引入了一些改进,例如简化了每个层次的嵌入方式和具有模式和客观进展的多阶段课程。 这使得EmbeddingGemma 2能够设定跨越文本、视觉和音频基准的新的Pareto边框,往往比专家和通用模型大好几倍。 EmbeddingGemma 2在对重量进行量化、嵌入调试和模块化编码器加载的本土支持下,使高质量的多模式嵌入在资源约束和安装上实用。 我们向社区开放EmbeddingGemma 2检查站,以加速研究和开发,既用于现成的用途,也作为基础的多式联运编码器。
